title: Science: full-edge finite-frequency gravity pole survival
science: Block 47: preserves the raw 99-term analytic Laurent symbol at complex temporal momentum, quotients all four displacement-Ward columns, and shows one complete-edge pole per transverse parity sector surviving at 36 wave numbers with a uniformly gapped nonmetric remainder — extending the Block-44 IR theorem to finite frequency and localizing the transfer/inner-product question.
carried_by: #6141 consumes these sampled poles (ruling out their direct one-step transfer reading) and #6144 resolves the transfer question with the positive-OS two-TT family; ancestry of #7753
